name: LKL
recent: LKL 近期签署了多份谅解备忘录，并出现董事会成员变动，包括 Dato' Haji Mohd Yazid bin Haji Mustafa 与 Mr Ti Lian Seng 的职位调整。此外，Mr Ang Kian You 申报不再是大股东。公司也发布了截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的业绩。
notable: 签署了多份谅解备忘录 (MOU)。
董事会成员出现变动，涉及 Dato' Haji Mohd Yazid bin Haji Mustafa 与 Mr Ti Lian Seng。
Mr Ang Kian You 申报不再是大股东。

recent_en: LKL recently entered into several memoranda of understanding and saw boardroom changes involving Dato' Haji Mohd Yazid bin Haji Mustafa and Mr Ti Lian Seng. Mr Ang Kian You also ceased to be a substantial shareholder. The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026.
notable_en: Entered into several memoranda of understanding (MOUs).
Boardroom changes involving Dato' Haji Mohd Yazid bin Haji Mustafa and Mr Ti Lian Seng.
Mr Ang Kian You ceased to be a substantial shareholder.
